title: PD-1 nonresponse investigation · synthetic team project
description: Invented research scenario for testing evidence selection, conflicting findings, cohort summaries and hypothesis handoff. No real patients, publications or trial outcomes.

sources.title: Synthetic research report A · tissue profiling
Synthetic research report B · replication study
Synthetic research report C · assay comparison

evidence.assertion: In the invented tissue dataset, the selected CD8-state score was higher in nonresponding samples.
evidence.passage: Synthetic result: the prespecified score differed between the two response groups at baseline.
evidence.studyContext: Synthetic pretreatment tissue series; exploratory association; no causal inference.
evidence.limitation: Small synthetic series and unvalidated score; effect size intentionally not supplied.

evidence.assertion: The invented replication series did not reproduce the baseline CD8-state association.
evidence.passage: Synthetic result: the baseline score showed no detectable group difference in the replication series.
evidence.studyContext: Synthetic independent tissue series; different collection protocol and processing window.
evidence.limitation: Protocol differences may explain disagreement; no claim of biological equivalence.

evidence.assertion: An invented PD-L1 measurement was associated with response in the exploratory dataset.
evidence.passage: Synthetic result: response frequency differed across the assay-defined research groups.
evidence.studyContext: Synthetic exploratory assay; research grouping only, no clinical threshold.
evidence.limitation: Missing specimens and assay-specific grouping prevent transport to clinical use.

evidence.assertion: The invented alternate-assay study did not preserve the PD-L1 response association.
evidence.passage: Synthetic result: changing the research assay changed group membership and removed the observed association.
evidence.studyContext: Synthetic alternate assay and specimen processing; no calibrated cross-assay threshold.
evidence.limitation: Cannot distinguish measurement effects from cohort differences.

evidence.assertion: The invented cell-model perturbation altered a research immune-escape readout.
evidence.passage: Synthetic result: the perturbed cell model differed from its matched control on the prespecified readout.
evidence.locator: Invented Methods and Results, experiment B
evidence.studyContext: Synthetic in-vitro model only; not evidence of a patient mechanism.
evidence.limitation: No validation in human tissue or independent laboratory.

evidence.assertion: The invented research protocol records specimen timing as a potential confounder.
evidence.passage: Synthetic protocol: collection time and prior exposure should be captured before interpreting the readout.
evidence.studyContext: Synthetic protocol context; no tested outcome.
evidence.limitation: Background design note provides no direct support or contradiction.

cohorts.limitation: Unadjusted synthetic counts; not a real drug or trial estimate.

cohorts.limitation: Different population, assay and window; do not rank interventions.

cohorts.assay: Fictional tissue panel v1 with different processing
cohorts.limitation: Replication workflow fixture; no real efficacy conclusion.
